description:
**Senior .NET AI Engineer – Phoenix, AZ (Hybrid)** 




**Duration:** 
 6–12\+ Months \| Possible Extension/Conversion
 



**Max Rate:** 
 $60/hr C2C
 



**Location:** 
 4000 E. Sky Harbor Blvd, Phoenix, AZ 85034
 



**Interview:** 
 2nd Round In\-Person
 



**Work Authorization:** 
 USC, GC, GC\-EAD, H4\-EAD
 



**Local Candidates Only** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Senior .NET AI Engineer / Full Stack Product Engineer** 
 to modernize legacy applications and workflows within a Safety, Environmental \& Compliance environment.
 



 The ideal candidate will have
 **7–9 years of software engineering experience** 
 with strong hands\-on expertise in
 **C\#, .NET/.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, REST APIs, SQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL, Azure, CI/CD, and automated testing** 
 .
 



  





 Strong
 **AI/GenAI experience is required** 
 , including exposure to
 **LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, agentic AI workflows, or cloud\-based AI platforms** 
 .
 



  





**Must Have:** 



* 7–9 years software engineering experience
* C\#, .NET/.NET Core
* Angular \& TypeScript
* REST APIs / backend services
* Oracle/PostgreSQL/SQL
* Legacy application modernization
* Git / CI/CD
* Automated testing
* **Generative AI / LLM / AI\-assisted development experience**



  





**Preferred:** 
 Azure, MongoDB, GitHub Actions, Playwright, prompt engineering, agentic AI, Azure AI/cloud AI services.
